prompt: Create an artistic poster exploring the concept of 'synaptic architecture' - the idea that neural connections form visible spatial structures. I want you to develop a complete design philosophy around this concept and then express it visually as a sophisticated, museum-quality poster. The final deliverable should be a single PDF file named 'synaptic_architecture_poster.pdf' and include the design philosophy as 'design_philosophy.md'. Make this look like it took countless hours of expert craftsmanship - something that could be displayed in a contemporary art museum.
